summary: John's maternal 2nd great-grandmother; Guardia Lombardi-born wife of grocer John Petriello, mother of James.
bio: Tree: 'Marie Dibiase', parents Giovanni P. Dibiasi (b. 1829) + Rosa Siconolfi (b. 1840). Geni names John's wife as Maria Antonia DiBiasi. FS tree GQWT-LLS: born 1870 Italy, died 5 Jul 1935 (Scranton). 1910 census: Marie, 40, mother of 6 children, all 6 living, immigration 1880; 1920 census: Mary, 43, immigration 1892. 1931 license: 'Mary Dibiasa', born Italy. Listed as dead on son Anthony's 1941 marriage license. Her brother (probable) was Domenico Antonio DiBiasi (b. 28 Sep 1856 Guardia, d. 8 Feb 1922 Scranton). Her birth act was not found: the Guardia Nati 1870 register has no index and needs a page-by-page scan (63 images). The 1850-54 Guardia marriage indexes were downloaded in Round 3 (ital/img/mi185x_m*.jpg) but not read, for her parents' marriage. Context: a Francesco De Biasi, 72, was the declarant at her father-in-law Pietro Petriello's death in 1901. A modern Guardia phone directory lists Di Biasi (12); paese.app counts 5 Di Biase arrivals from Guardia 1830-1912.
